subject: Reseller addendum — commission timing & billing flow (redlines)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller addendum — initial redlines (commission & billing)

Sara — attaching our proposed redlines to the marketplace/reseller addendum. High-level calls out: commission remittance schedule, invoice pass-through, and limited liability carveouts tied to marketplace terms.

As requested in the demo last week, we've kept the marketplace flow intact but asked for a clear invoice remittance cadence (30 days after invoice receipt) and a reconciliation window (60 days) — see Section 3 of the attached. Also flagged indemnity and warranty language where it conflicts with our MSA.

Next steps: can your legal team review the tracked changes and confirm whether you can accept the pass-through billing flow or whether you need a reseller invoice-first model? If you prefer invoice-first we will need to route through finance for PO/credit terms.

Attachments: redlines_marketplace_addendum_20260624.docx (docx), payment_flow_diagram_v3.png (png)

Thanks,
Ben

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudresell.com>

Cc: David Liu <david.liu@partner-legal.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — initial redlines (commission & billing)

Ben — thanks for sending. Quick note from our side after a first pass with counsel: we can accept pass-through billing in principle but need clarification on two operational points that will affect our payment terms:

- Who issues the invoice to the end-customer (CloudResell or Redwood) in a mediated marketplace sale?
- What is the remittance timeline for our commission — do we get paid net-30 from Redwood’s receipt of customer payment, or net-30 from Redwood invoice issuance?

Also attaching one small redline from our GC: a carveout that prevents upstream marketplace platform liability from eroding our reseller indemnities. See inline comment on Section 6.

Happy to set a 30-minute sync if that helps. David (cc) will drive legal feedback.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel | Head of Partnerships | CloudResell Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudresell.com>, David Liu <david.liu@partner-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — initial redlines (commission & billing)

Quick note to align Redwood on operational prefs before legal gets deep into edits.

Ben/Marissa — from a product and revenue ops standpoint we strongly prefer that Redwood issue the customer-facing invoice (marketplace passthrough) and treat CloudResell as the reseller for commission calculations. This keeps tax and usage reporting centralized and preserves our audit trail for SLO-related credits. The downside is we need to make the commission remittance timing explicit to satisfy CloudResell’s treasury: I recommend we commit to "commission payment within 30 days of Redwood receiving cleared funds from the customer" with a 60-day reconciliation window.

David — if your team could accept language that ties commission payment to "receipt of cleared funds" rather than "Redwood invoice issuance", that will reduce financing friction. If CloudResell can't accept that, we need to know whether they require Redwood to pre-fund commissions on a net-30 basis (which would be a commercial ask).

Operational asks for Redwood team:
- Marissa: confirm whether finance can support the 30/60 cadence and whether we need a short-side advance option for smaller partners.
- Ben: propose one line to add to the addendum that defines "cleared funds" and the reconciliation process.
- Vanessa: loop in Marketplace Ops for the invoice flow diagram validation.

Thanks — can we get replies by Monday so we can circle back with CloudResell legal?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Manager, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <invoices@cloudresell.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — initial redlines (commission & billing)

Thanks Karthik — checked with finance. We can support the "commission payment within 30 days of Redwood receiving cleared funds" approach provided CloudResell accepts:

- A 60-day reconciliation window for short/overpayments; adjustments will be netted on the next payment cycle.
- Standard withholding for chargebacks/credits tied to SLO refunds for customer incidents.
- For partners requesting pre-funding, we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis (requires CRO sign-off and results in a short-term credit line).

Suggested contract language (for Ben to drop into the addendum):
"For marketplace transactions where Redwood issues the customer invoice, commissions due to Reseller shall be paid within thirty (30) days after Redwood’s receipt of cleared customer funds. Redwood and Reseller shall reconcile commission calculations within sixty (60) days of payment, and any overpayment or underpayment shall be settled in the subsequent payment cycle. Redwood reserves the right to withhold commission amounts reasonably related to chargebacks, credits, or SLO-related refunds as described in the Order Form."

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudresell.com>, David Liu <david.liu@partner-legal.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — initial redlines (commission & billing)

Sara/David — appreciate the quick turn. Per internal alignment below, Redwood can accept pass-through marketplace billing with the following key points captured into the addendum (tracked in the attached):

- Redwood will issue customer invoices for marketplace sales.
- Commissions payable to CloudResell shall be paid within thirty (30) days after Redwood’s receipt of cleared customer funds; parties will reconcile within sixty (60) days.
- Redwood will withhold amounts reasonably tied to chargebacks/SLO refunds; these will be documented on reconciliation reports.
- Liability: Redwood is comfortable adding limited carveouts to protect Reseller from upstream platform liabilities so long as the carveouts do not expand Redwood’s indemnity beyond the MSA baseline.

Request: David, can your team review the attached tracked changes and confirm whether the proposed wording on "cleared funds" and the reconciliation mechanics are acceptable. If so, we'll prep a clean copy and route for signature. If CloudResell requires pre-funding or a guaranteed net-30 payment tied to Redwood invoice issuance, let us know ASAP — that is a commercial exception.

Thanks — copying Vanessa for Ops validation; Ben will follow up with a 30-minute redline call invite if helpful.

Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
